cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth at The Paropakar Maternity and Women's Hospital, a tertiary level hospital in Kathmandu, Nepal, between September 17 and December 18 of 2017
finding: Women with preeclampsia had a higher risk of cesarean section and preterm birth compared to women with gestational hypertension or normal pregnancies.
mod_finding: Preeclampsia was strongly associated with cesarean section compared to normal pregnancies (OR = 8.11, p<0.001), while the odds of cesarean section among women with gestational hypertension was almost 2 times higher (OR = 1.89, p<0.001).
